A null next_cursor means that the captured result has no further page. Results are captured once for a query. Files created after that capture do not appear in later pages of the same result. message.content:
# API Migration Note: Pagination Response Change (Version 2)

Version 2 adds the `next_cursor` field to the pagination response. Version 1 clients continue to receive their existing `items` field; that field is not being removed.

A null `next_cursor` means the captured result has no further page. Results are captured once per query; files created after that capture do not appear in later pages of the same result. A caller needing current files must start a new query rather than expecting the cursor to refresh the tree. Cursor state expires when the run is retired.

There is no change to write permissions or file ownership as part of this API change.

Next action: update the client example to follow `next_cursor` until it is null.

Evidence reference: api-pagination-2.
